title: "Comping rhythm: Ballad: rocking"

This is a lesson on one comping rhythm the [Backing Track](../../tools/backing-track.qmd) band plays: **Ballad: rocking**. It is built up from 2 simpler patterns, one step at a time, and every step is played by the band and written out as it plays. How the examples work: press ▶ Play, switch players in and out with the buttons beside it, and read what the band will play on the staff underneath: the whole pass is written out when Play starts, before it sounds. The tempo slider at the bottom of the page slows everything down.

[All the accompaniment patterns](index.qmd) · [Comping rhythms](index.qmd#chords)

## The pattern

Quarter notes: the chord on 1, the thumb on 2, the top two notes on 3, the thumb on 4, over held left-hand octaves on the root. On the piano with the Standard voicing the chord is a triad in first inversion.

It belongs in *Piano ballad*, *Acoustic strum*, *Folk carol*, *Hymn (four parts)* and *12/8 doo-wop*. Here it is in the piano ballad style with the whole band. Switch the other players off to hear it alone.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="pop" data-chart="C|Am|F|G" data-tempo="72" data-on="bass comp drums congas" data-staves="comp" data-comp="piano" data-choice-label="Comping rhythm:" data-choices='[{"label":"Ballad: rocking","opts":{"compRhythm":"ballRock"}}]'></div>

## Step 1: Quarter-note chords

Start with something simpler. The chord on every beat, held. On the piano the left hand adds the root underneath as each chord arrives: Let It Be, Imagine, Someone Like You.

This is a pattern of its own: [the lesson on it](chords-quarters.qmd) takes it further. Here it is only a step on the way, slowly. The drums keep time with you; switch the others on when it is steady.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="pop" data-chart="C|Am|F|G" data-tempo="50" data-on="comp drums" data-staves="comp" data-comp="piano" data-choice-label="Step:" data-choices='[{"label":"Quarter-note chords","opts":{"compRhythm":"quarters"}}]'></div>

## Step 2: Hymn: four parts

Every chord played once and held until the next one. On the piano or organ it is four parts: the root in the left hand and three voices above it that move as little as possible from chord to chord. It follows the chart's chords, so a carol written with a chord on every beat sounds like the hymnal.

This is a pattern of its own: [the lesson on it](chords-hymn.qmd) takes it further. Here it is only a step on the way, slowly. The drums keep time with you; switch the others on when it is steady.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="pop" data-chart="C|Am|F|G" data-tempo="50" data-on="comp drums" data-staves="comp" data-comp="piano" data-choice-label="Step:" data-choices='[{"label":"Hymn: four parts","opts":{"compRhythm":"hymn"}}]'></div>

## Step 3: Ballad: rocking, slowly

Now the pattern itself. Compare it with the step before: press each button while the band plays and watch what changes on the staff.

**How to play it.** Left hand: an octave on the root, held. Right hand in quarter notes: the whole chord on 1, the thumb on 2, the top two notes on 3, the thumb on 4. The right hand rocks between the thumb and the top.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="pop" data-chart="C|Am|F|G" data-tempo="50" data-on="comp drums" data-staves="comp" data-comp="piano" data-choice-label="Compare:" data-choices='[{"label":"Ballad: rocking","opts":{"compRhythm":"ballRock"}},{"label":"Hymn: four parts (the step before)","opts":{"compRhythm":"hymn"}}]'></div>

## Step 4: Up to tempo, with the band

The whole band, at 72 beats a minute. Play along, then switch the band's chord player off and take the part yourself.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="pop" data-chart="C|Am|F|G" data-tempo="72" data-on="bass comp drums congas" data-staves="comp bass" data-comp="piano" data-choice-label="Comping rhythm:" data-choices='[{"label":"Ballad: rocking","opts":{"compRhythm":"ballRock"}}]'></div>

## Step 5: Two chords in a bar

Harder: now some bars have two chords, two beats each. The pattern keeps its rhythm and changes chord where the bar does: watch the staff for the hit that lands on beat 3.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="pop" data-chart="C G|Am F|Dm G|C" data-tempo="72" data-on="bass comp drums congas" data-staves="comp bass" data-comp="piano" data-choice-label="Comping rhythm:" data-choices='[{"label":"Ballad: rocking","opts":{"compRhythm":"ballRock"}}]'></div>
